subject: general
question: What is the key objective of the Swachh Diwali Shubh Diwali campaign 2024?

options.text: Promoting cleanliness and sustainability during Diwali

solution:
The correct answer is __**Promoting cleanliness and sustainability during Diwali**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The "Swachh Diwali Shubh Diwali" campaign aims to **promote cleanliness and sustainability** during the Diwali festival.
 
• The initiative focuses on **reducing pollution** caused by firecrackers and other Diwali-related activities.
 
• It encourages **eco-friendly practices** such as using biodegradable decorations and organic rangoli colors.
 
• The campaign is aligned with the broader **Swachh Bharat Abhiyan** (Clean India Mission), aiming to enhance public hygiene and environmental health.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Swachh Bharat Abhiyan**:

 
 
• Launched on October 2, 2014, by PM Narendra Modi, this mission aims to achieve universal sanitation coverage.
 
• The primary goal is to eliminate open defecation and improve solid waste management.
 
 
 
• **Eco-Friendly Diwali**:
 
 
• Encourages the use of LED lights over traditional oil lamps to conserve energy.
 
• Promotes the use of natural materials for decorations and minimizing plastic waste.
 
 
 
• **Air Pollution During Diwali**:
 
 
• Firecrackers release harmful chemicals like sulfur dioxide, carbon monoxide, and particulate matter, which contribute to air pollution.
 
• Authorities often implement temporary bans or restrictions on firecrackers to reduce pollution levels.
 
 
 
• **Community Involvement**:
 
 
• Local communities are encouraged to participate in cleanliness drives and awareness programs.
 
• Educational institutions often conduct workshops and campaigns to teach students about the importance of sustainability during festivals.
